<solution task="t1-digits">
goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    goyu n <- druwol(line).
    goyu neg <- n < 0.
    goyu m <- n.
    dre neg ethur
        m <- 0 - n.
    wodrotru dre
    goyu sum <- 0.
    goyu rev <- 0.
    omethol m > 0
        sum <- sum + (m trumguwu 10).
        rev <- rev * 10 + (m trumguwu 10).
        m <- m / 10.
    shusushe
    goyu rs <- shodrewe(rev).
    dre neg ethur
        rs <- "-" & rs.
    wodrotru dre
    suwe shodrewe(sum) & " " & rs.

<solution task="t1-floordiv">
dredrume splitws(s)
    goyu toks <- [].
    goyu cur <- "".
    goyu n <- wumdror(s).
    wego i <- 0 setru n - 1
        dre s[i] == " " ethur
            dre wumdror(cur) > 0 ethur
                dreme(toks, cur).
                cur <- "".
            wodrotru dre
        truthor
            cur <- cur & s[i].
        wodrotru dre
    trer i
    dre wumdror(cur) > 0 ethur
        dreme(toks, cur).
    wodrotru dre
    odrol toks.
wodrotru dredrume

goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    goyu t <- splitws(line).
    goyu a <- druwol(t[0]).
    goyu b <- druwol(t[1]).
    goyu q <- a / b.
    dre (a trumguwu b != 0) suyogur ((a < 0) != (b < 0)) ethur
        q <- q - 1.
    wodrotru dre
    goyu r <- a - b * q.
    suwe shodrewe(q) & " " & shodrewe(r).
    line <- uyotho().
shusushe
</solution>

<solution task="t1-palindromes">
dredrume lowerch(c)
    goyu U <- "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".
    goyu L <- "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".
    wego i <- 0 setru 25
        dre U[i] == c ethur
            odrol L[i].
        wodrotru dre
    trer i
    odrol c.
wodrotru dredrume

goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    goyu f <- "".
    wego i <- 0 setru wumdror(line) - 1
        goyu c <- line[i].
        goyu al <- (c >= "0" suyogur c <= "9") drorsu (c >= "A" suyogur c <= "Z") drorsu (c >= "a" suyogur c <= "z").
        dre al ethur
            f <- f & lowerch(c).
        wodrotru dre
    trer i
    goyu i <- 0.
    goyu j <- wumdror(f) - 1.
    goyu ok <- sudru.
    omethol i < j suyogur ok
        dre f[i] != f[j] ethur
            ok <- tru.
        wodrotru dre
        i <- i + 1.
        j <- j - 1.
    shusushe
    dre ok ethur
        suwe "yes".
    truthor
        suwe "no".
    wodrotru dre
    line <- uyotho().

<solution task="t2-bignum">
dredrume dig(c)
    goyu D <- "0123456789".
    wego i <- 0 setru 9
        dre D[i] == c ethur
            odrol i.
        wodrotru dre
    trer i
    odrol -1.
wodrotru dredrume

dredrume splitws(s)
    goyu toks <- [].
    goyu cur <- "".
    goyu n <- wumdror(s).
    wego i <- 0 setru n - 1
        dre s[i] == " " ethur
            dre wumdror(cur) > 0 ethur
                dreme(toks, cur).
                cur <- "".
            wodrotru dre
        truthor
            cur <- cur & s[i].
        wodrotru dre
    trer i
    dre wumdror(cur) > 0 ethur
        dreme(toks, cur).
    wodrotru dre
    odrol toks.
wodrotru dredrume

dredrume badd(a, b)
    goyu D <- "0123456789".
    goyu i <- wumdror(a) - 1.
    goyu j <- wumdror(b) - 1.
    goyu carry <- 0.
    goyu res <- "".
    omethol i >= 0 drorsu j >= 0 drorsu carry == 1
        goyu da <- 0.
        dre i >= 0 ethur
            da <- dig(a[i]).
        wodrotru dre
        goyu db <- 0.
        dre j >= 0 ethur
            db <- dig(b[j]).
        wodrotru dre
        goyu s <- da + db + carry.
        carry <- s / 10.
        res <- D[s trumguwu 10] & res.
        i <- i - 1.
        j <- j - 1.
    shusushe
    odrol res.
wodrotru dredrume

dredrume bmul(a, b)
    goyu D <- "0123456789".
    goyu la <- wumdror(a).
    goyu lb <- wumdror(b).
    goyu n <- la + lb.
    goyu arr <- [].
    wego i <- 0 setru n - 1
        dreme(arr, 0).
    trer i
    wego ii <- 0 setru la - 1
        goyu da <- dig(a[ii]).
        wego jj <- 0 setru lb - 1
            goyu k <- (la - 1 - ii) + (lb - 1 - jj).
            arr[k] <- arr[k] + da * dig(b[jj]).
        trer jj
    trer ii
    goyu carry <- 0.
    wego k <- 0 setru n - 1
        goyu tot <- arr[k] + carry.
        arr[k] <- tot trumguwu 10.
        carry <- tot / 10.
    trer k
    goyu h <- n - 1.
    omethol h > 0 suyogur arr[h] == 0
        h <- h - 1.
    shusushe
    dre arr[h] == 0 ethur
        odrol "0".
    wodrotru dre
    goyu res <- "".
    wego k <- h setru 0 meshe -1
        res <- res & D[arr[k]].
    trer k
    odrol res.
wodrotru dredrume

goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    goyu t <- splitws(line).
    suwe badd(t[0], t[1]) & " " & bmul(t[0], t[1]).
    line <- uyotho().
shusushe
</solution>

<solution task="t2-life">
goyu g <- druwol(uyotho()).
goyu grid <- [].
goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    goyu row <- [].
    wego c <- 0 setru wumdror(line) - 1
        dre line[c] == "#" ethur
            dreme(row, 1).
        truthor
            dreme(row, 0).
        wodrotru dre
    trer c
    dreme(grid, row).
    line <- uyotho().
shusushe
goyu R <- wumdror(grid).
goyu C <- 0.
dre R > 0 ethur
    C <- wumdror(grid[0]).
wodrotru dre
wego gen <- 1 setru g
    goyu ng <- [].
    wego r <- 0 setru R - 1
        goyu nrow <- [].
        wego c <- 0 setru C - 1
            goyu cnt <- 0.
            wego dr <- -1 setru 1
                wego dc <- -1 setru 1
                    dre dr == 0 suyogur dc == 0 ethur
                        omgu.
                    wodrotru dre
                    goyu rr <- r + dr.
                    goyu cc <- c + dc.
                    dre rr >= 0 suyogur rr < R suyogur cc >= 0 suyogur cc < C ethur
                        cnt <- cnt + grid[rr][cc].
                    wodrotru dre
                trer dc
            trer dr
            goyu alive <- 0.
            dre grid[r][c] == 1 ethur
                dre cnt == 2 drorsu cnt == 3 ethur
                    alive <- 1.
                wodrotru dre
            wodrotru dre
            dre grid[r][c] == 0 suyogur cnt == 3 ethur
                alive <- 1.
            wodrotru dre
            dreme(nrow, alive).
        trer c
        dreme(ng, nrow).
    trer r
    grid <- ng.
trer gen
wego r <- 0 setru R - 1
    wego c <- 0 setru C - 1
        dre grid[r][c] == 1 ethur
            wemgego "#".
        truthor
            wemgego ".".
        wodrotru dre
    trer c
    suwe "".
trer r
</solution>

<solution task="t2-wordfreq">
dredrume lowerch(c)
    goyu U <- "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".
    goyu L <- "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".
    wego i <- 0 setru 25
        dre U[i] == c ethur
            odrol L[i].
        wodrotru dre
    trer i
    odrol c.
wodrotru dredrume

dredrume isLetter(c)
    odrol (c >= "A" suyogur c <= "Z") drorsu (c >= "a" suyogur c <= "z").
wodrotru dredrume

dredrume before(p, q)
    dre p[1] > q[1] ethur
        odrol sudru.
    wodrotru dre
    dre p[1] < q[1] ethur
        odrol tru.
    wodrotru dre
    odrol p[0] < q[0].
wodrotru dredrume

goyu words <- [].
goyu cnts <- [].
goyu n <- 0.
goyu line <- uyotho().
omethol line != gursume
    goyu cur <- "".
    wego i <- 0 setru wumdror(line) - 1
        goyu c <- line[i].
        dre isLetter(c) ethur
            cur <- cur & lowerch(c).
        truthor
            dre wumdror(cur) > 0 ethur
                goyu idx <- -1.
                wego j <- 0 setru n - 1
                    dre words[j] == cur ethur
                        idx <- j.
                    wodrotru dre
                trer j
                dre idx >= 0 ethur
                    cnts[idx] <- cnts[idx] + 1.
                truthor
                    dreme(words, cur).
                    dreme(cnts, 1).
                    n <- n + 1.
                wodrotru dre
                cur <- "".
            wodrotru dre
        wodrotru dre
    trer i
    dre wumdror(cur) > 0 ethur
        goyu idx <- -1.
        wego j <- 0 setru n - 1
            dre words[j] == cur ethur
                idx <- j.
            wodrotru dre
        trer j
        dre idx >= 0 ethur
            cnts[idx] <- cnts[idx] + 1.
        truthor
            dreme(words, cur).
            dreme(cnts, 1).
            n <- n + 1.
        wodrotru dre
    wodrotru dre
    line <- uyotho().
shusushe
goyu pairs <- [].
wego i <- 0 setru n - 1
    dreme(pairs, [words[i], cnts[i]]).
trer i
wego i <- 0 setru n - 1
    wego j <- 0 setru n - 2 - i
        dre before(pairs[j + 1], pairs[j]) ethur
            goyu tmp <- pairs[j].
            pairs[j] <- pairs[j + 1].
            pairs[j + 1] <- tmp.
        wodrotru dre
    trer j
trer i
goyu lim <- n.
dre lim > 10 ethur
    lim <- 10.
wodrotru dre
wego i <- 0 setru lim - 1
    suwe pairs[i][0] & " " & shodrewe(pairs[i][1]).
trer i
</solution>
message.reasoning_content:
Let me carefully read the Gutrur reference and then solve each task.

Key facts about Gutrur:
- Keywords: dre (if), dredrume (function), drorsu (or), ethur (part of if), ewuyo (part of repeat-until), goyu (var decl), gugum (case in switch), gursume (none), meshe (part of counting loop), odrol (return), omethol (while), omgu (continue), setru (part of counting loop), sho (part of repeat-until), shogu (not), shusushe (end while), sudru (true), suwe (print with newline), suyogur (and), trer (end counting loop), treyur (repeat), trumguwu (remainder), truthor (else part), wego (counting loop), wem (switch), wemgego (print without newline), wodrotru (end), wuyem (break), yuyuge (elif).

Important semantics:
- Counting loop `wego i <- start setru limit meshe step` includes the limit. Runs while variable has not passed the limit. With negative step, goes down to limit inclusive.
- `/` rounds toward zero. `trumguwu` is `a - b * (a/b)` so sign follows dividend (like C). NOT floor division.
- `%` in RPN task: rounds toward zero, `a % b = a - b*(a/b)` with truncation. So Gutrur `trumguwu` matches exactly! Good. But need to check for div by zero errors.
- Conditions must be booleans (no truthiness).
- Logical and/or operands must be booleans. Short circuit.
- Strings indexable: `s[i]` gives one-char string. Lists mutable, shared.
- `druwol` converts string to integer; integer returned unchanged. So druwol(" 12 ") works (surrounding spaces allowed).
- `shodrewe` converts to printing string.
- `wumdror` length of list or string.
- No char-to-int builtin! Important. For palindromes, weekday (Sakamoto), digits, wordfreq lowercasing, we need character manipulation. We have string indexing `s[i]` gives a one-char string, and string comparison with `<` etc by char code. But no direct char code arithmetic. Hmm.

We need a way to compare a character to ranges. We can compare strings with `<`, `<=` etc. So to check if `c` is a digit: `c >= "0" suyogur c <= "9"` — wait `suyogur` requires booleans; comparisons give booleans, so `c >= "0" suyogur c <= "9"` works. Good.

To check letter A-Z: `c >= "A" suyogur c <= "Z"`. a-z similarly. Note ordering is character code, so this works for ASCII.

Lowercasing a letter: no arithmetic on chars directly. But we can build a mapping. For wordfreq we need to map uppercase to lowercase. We could create a string of all letters and find index via searching? Without char arithmetic, we can do: for a char c, find position in "ABC...Z" by scanning; that position in "abc...z" gives lowercase. That's O(26) per char, fine.

Actually we can compare char codes only via ordering, but to map we need lookup table approach: build string upper = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", lower = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz". For each char, scan upper; if found at index j, use lower[j]. That gives lowercase. Good.

For weekday: We can use a known algorithm that needs arithmetic on date components (integers), not char codes. We need to extract year, month, day from "YYYY-MM-DD". Since format fixed, we can use druwol on substrings. But substring? No substring builtin! We have indexing `s[i]` to get one char, and length. We can build number by iterating chars: year = 0; for i 0..3: year = year*10 + (digit value of s[i]). But digit value of a char needs char->int. We can map char "0".."9" to 0..9 by comparing? Need numeric. Approach: build a string "0123456789" and find index — but finding index needs comparison loop. For each digit char, scan j 0..9 until digits[j]==c, then j is value. That's fine and cheap.

Alternatively use druwol on a constructed substring: we can build a substring by concatenating chars: `druwol(s[0] & s[1] & s[2] & s[3])` — since s[i] is a one-char string, concatenation builds "2000", druwol gives 2000. That's much simpler! Great. Month = druwol(s[5] & s[6]), day = druwol(s[8] & s[9]). Nice.

For Sakamoto's algorithm:
